string.text: Sets the NVIDIA DLSS internal render scale. DLAA renders at native resolution. Quality, Balanced, Performance and Ultra Performance use progressively lower internal resolutions to gain FPS. Applying this setting recreates video resources.

Sets the AMD FSR 3 internal render scale. Native AA renders at native resolution. Quality, Balanced, Performance and Ultra Performance use progressively lower internal resolutions to gain FPS. Applying this setting recreates video resources.

Selects the NVIDIA DLSS model. Presets not supported by the loaded DLSS library are grayed out. %c[yellow] 
CNN:
F - legacy CNN model (deprecated). %c[green] 
Transformer:
J - less ghosting, more flicker (NVIDIA recommends K).
K - 1st-gen transformer, default for DLAA / Quality / Balanced.
L - 2nd-gen transformer, sharper and slower, default for Ultra Performance (RTX 40+).
M - 2nd-gen transformer, similar to L but faster, default for Performance (RTX 40+). Default follows NVIDIA / driver OTA.
When XeGTAO is selected, enables bent normals for more accurate diffuse ambient occlusion shading. Requires a video restart (vid_restart).
